title: Founder Access Continuity Organizer
target_customer: Solo founders and one-person businesses who are the single point of failure for everything the business needs
problem: If a solo founder is unreachable, nobody else knows what the business runs on or how to restore access, and writing passwords on paper is the unsafe answer

demand_signals.signal: Multiple independent sellers ship a paid 'business continuity / emergency access / digital legacy' product, at prices from $6.75 to $79.
demand_signals.interpretation: Proven, non-trivial willingness to pay for a packaged continuity/access plan.

demand_signals.signal: The niche's own best-selling descriptions repeat the same two specific jobs: an asset/account inventory that maps what exists (never the secrets), AND a 'what happens if I am unreachable' continuity page.
demand_signals.evidence: Verified quotes from the live product pages (The Divine Business Legacy Vault, IF I CAN'T, The Solo Ager Planner, The Twenty Page Emergency Binder).
demand_signals.interpretation: The exact two jobs this product ships are the ones the market articulates itself.

demand_signals.signal: The dominant doctrine across the category is 'map, not vault' - do not write passwords on paper; use a password manager's emergency access.
demand_signals.evidence: 'how to reach the accounts safely, without writing a single password down' (The Twenty Page Emergency Binder); 'maps what exists ... never the account numbers themselves' (The Solo Ager Planner).
demand_signals.interpretation: Our never-write-a-password design is aligned with, not contrary to, the category's own practice.

competition_level: MEDIUM-HIGH (14 paid comparables; two clusters - direct business continuity $37-$79, and closest-shape single-download packs $6.75-$20.22).
differentiation_risk: MEDIUM. A 2-file pack (8-page / 3,235-word guide + 6-sheet inventory workbook) is deeper than the $6.75-$20.22 packs on written guidance and adds a real working workbook; it is thinner in file count than the $37-$79 direct rivals. Differentiation is structure + clarity, not file count.

price.rationale: Cycle 99 founder directive (2026-10-19): B12-003 publication authorized; final price set by the directive's own rule - the highest price that passes every mandatory gate. USD 8.00 is the maximum price economics.market_realism_check permits for an 8-page guide (min($1.00 x 8 pages, $15.00 short-book ceiling) = $8.00); the previously recorded USD 19.00 FAILED that mandatory gate. It is priced below the direct business-continuity comparable cluster ($20.22-$79.00). Basis FOUNDER_DECISION_BELOW_COMPARABLE. Evidence: data/evidence/b12_003_competitors.json, this gate file.

verdict: SELECT_WITH_CAUTION - demand is proven across 14 real comparables and the two jobs this product ships are the ones the market names itself. The niche is competitive and our 2-file pack is thinner in count than the high end, so it must win on usefulness of the inventory + clarity of the guide.
note: Cycle 99: final price USD 8.00 - the highest price that clears the factory's mandatory market-realism policy for an 8-page guide. Supersedes the earlier $29.00 manifest price, the $14.99 recommendation and the interim $19.00 founder record (which failed that gate). See GATE_FINAL_2026-10-19.json.
